notes.title: Chaos Chain - Equipment Briefing
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[u]For those of you who missed the last announcement discussing my next project[/u], [i]Chaos Chain[/i], you can find that here to get you up to date: 

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/CorrosiveStudios/announcements/detail/5246117291297561777

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

[b]For those of you who already know of the new game, let's talk about equipment.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/64df151097805d3f020cf38222ae5ff5ab46baa3.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment[/h1] has always played a significant role in my past games. Having the right tools for the job at hand is extremely important in my opinion, so I try to put that into the game worlds.

For [i]Chaos Chain[/i], this will still apply, but the system has been expanded and improved from my other projects.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/e79ae69e93dd2b97e560bd4ca9c4d5fd258f6772.png[/img]

First, as you can hopefully see in the image above, weapons have a pretty significant stat-line. A lot is taken into account and much thought went into how the stats function and what ratings each weapon was given. It may look simplistic, but each specific stat has a lot of factors to think about such as handling, ease of use, accuracy, speed, range, capabilities of fire modes such as semi, burst, and auto. The engine is somewhat limited, but I have done my best so far (still a lot of room for improvement) to make weapons feel unique.

Second, I've done A LOT of work on improving the combat system. I can't really show it off here right now, but something I'd like to mention is an EXTREME focus on sound effects and quick-flow combat. Weapons have unique sound effects and animations so you can tell what you are using compared to your enemies. I have improved the default battle sound system to include a variety of sound effects for each event so it's not always the same exact boring sound. There are several sound effects for each event like for example an evasion/dodge has multiple sounds of its own and then there are special sounds for bullets missing or a melee weapon hitting someone. I personally think that sounds make or break a game - especially when you're hearing the same ones over... and over... and over.

So far, I have around 50 or so weapons which are mostly melee weapons and improvised weapons, but I have a handful of fictional (based on real) firearms across a variety of different archtypes including pistols, PDWs (personal defense weapons), SMGs (submachine guns), shotguns, assault rifles, battle rifles, carbines, sniper rifles, machine guns, rocket launchers, grenade launchers, special weapons, and even some exotic weaponry. Not all of these are ready yet, but that's the weapon archtype/class lineup I'm going for. Like in my first game, [i]Waste Walkers[/i], firearms will allow for different ammunition types such as full metal jacket, hollow point, armor piercing, buckshot, slugshot, and birdshot, and even more are planned to be added. Depending on your preference, the different ammunitions will provide different bonuses.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/dc388ee7d346efb58f2c76172103a2de5ecb95a9.png[/img]

Armor is the same way - they have a lot to take into account. One flaw of my previous games in my opinion is that armor resistances were very minor. A 5% here, maybe a lucky 15% there, etc. The idea was to stack up on resistances you favored with your combination of chosen gear. Most of the time, the numbers didn't add up enough to actually make any significant impact. That will NOT be the case here. The equipment slot system is more straight forward, but each slot has a specific purpose. Armor is armor. It should feel like it. In the above picture, you can see the current (subject to change) stats for the ballistic vest. The resistance percentages are high enough by themselves to actually protect you from different damage types, but they may be bolstered even more by accompanying gear in other slots such as the head slot for headgear or even the accessory slot.

Theoretically speaking, if your punk has 8 health remaining and an enemy thug stabs you with a shiv for 10 puncture damage (lucky roll) and you have a protection (armor) value of 2, a toughness of 4, and a 25% puncture resistance, you'll only take 3 damage. The detailed math: 10 damage - (2 protection - 4 toughness) * .75 = 3. That's pretty helpful. Taking a third of the dealt damage because of having decent armor instead of the full amount just kept you alive. A leather jacket (armor 1 with a puncture protection of 5%) would have left you dead in the street. The differences between armor types should no longer feel minimal.

That's all for now, I'll have more information soon!

Thanks for reading!

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

Hey everyone!

This is a quick balancing patch for hardcore mode. When I made it hardcore - I REALLY made it hardcore. To the point of almost being a little ridiculous. 

This aims to at least balance it a bit. It slightly lessens the severity of some of the bonuses to enemies when playing on hardcore mode and removes a few of the extra buffs that weren't necessary to begin with.

The changes here should hopefully make the Disgraced Hardcore achievement easier to obtain as well. Achievement hunters don't have to struggle so hard anymore.

[b]Update 1.5.4 Change Log:[/b]

Changes & Additions:
-Hardcore mode no longer gives enemies a boost to accuracy
-Hardcore mode enemy stat bonuses have been balanced to be more accessible (health and morale got +5% each but raw damage and raw armor got -5%)
-Hardcore mode no longer gives enemies a boost to critical chance
-Hardcore mode no longer gives enemies a boost to counter attack chance
-Hardcore mode no longer gives enemies a boost to counter other skills (morale based) chance

That's all for now!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Lawless Lands Unrest Expansion Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Hey everyone!

I'm posting this here so that everybody who plays our games has a chance to see it in case they're interested.

The wait is over! Lawless Lands Unrest is now available! It's been a long time in development, but the expansion is finally finished!

You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408290/Lawless_Lands_Unrest/

There were a bunch of patches released yesterday during testing, so it should be all set for everyone to enjoy, but as always, if you have any issues just let me know. The main game also received a patch for a typo that was found while testing the expansion.

[i]"The Devil's Harvest, 347... It began as only harrowing rumors from abroad, but a foul blight has come and infected most of the crops throughout the Sagerovian countryside. Following its arrival, a plague struck down nearly everyone in its path, leaving the survivors to clean up the mess of their fallen society... With the armies off, fighting in the war against Stothlheim, Sagerov is left scarcely defended and outlying settlements are helpless, and prime targets for callous invaders... An old and all-but-forgotten foe, hailing from the eastern steppes, the Horde has set its sights on the lonely farms and plague-weakened villages, leaving nothing but smoke, bodies, and ash, in their wake... Among those villages, Ravlova, resting in the Strastobol region, is a small and insignificant farming community, where people work from dawn till dusk, just to earn even a meager living. Two in particular are a husband and wife, Kolyask and Ridina, who're local farmers with a family, but they're also part of their village's militia. Charged with protecting their land and their neighbors, they are the last line of defense... This is their story..."[/i]


[list]
[*]New Storyline - Play as Kolyask or Ridina in their quest to protect their homeland and their family from vicious invaders in a large, several hour long campaign!
[*]New Side Quests - Over 30 new side stories and side objectives, all relevant to the evolving game world and storyline!
[*]New Characters - Two new main characters to choose from, various new side characters, and even a handful of new companions and a Sagerovian hound!
[*]New Skills - Learn some new skills and abilities to give you an edge against your foes!
[*]New Equipment - Many new items and equipment like firebombs, armor such as brigandine and lamellar, and weapons to try out! 
[*]New Schematics - Demonstrate your ingenuity by creating your own equipment with new schematics and recipes!
[*]New Artwork - New character sprite graphics, portraits, environmental art, and more!
[*]New Map - Explore the Strastobol Region, set in the borderlands of Sagerov!
[*]New Enemies - Fight against fierce new enemies and a new faction known as The Horde!
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hands of Fate Expansion DLC Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628220/Disgraced_Hands_of_Fate_DLC/

[b]Hands of Fate Expansion DLC:[/b]

The Hands of Fate Expansion for Disgraced adds an extra system for replayability and for creating unique playthroughs and challenges. The system will randomly select up to 4 of 10 possible world modifiers that each have a unique effect on gameplay and the game world. These may be rerolled up to 5 times so you can choose which ones you want to play with. It can either be activated by starting a new game, or by simply accessing your supply cache in your headquarters.

[list]
To the Death: All vitality damage in battle can be up to 2 points higher.
Suppression: The Shogun will retaliate faster than usual, but you'll begin with extra influence.
Veterancy: Start at rank 2, but enemies may also start 1 rank higher.
Brutality: All criticals count for 3x damage instead of the standard 2x damage.
Lone Wolf: Your maximum company size is reduced by 1, but your character gains a boost to each virtue.
Spoils of War: Start off with an extra 30 ryo, but the enemies are better equipped.
Ronin: You gain experience 10% faster, but enemy samurai will have 10% more vitality.
Wild Weather: The weather will shift more often and it will be more stormy.
Fate's Favor: No effects good or bad. You lucked out.
Rabid Wolves: Wolves deal more damage and have a higher critical chance, but less vitality and morale.
[/list]

*For those of you who have played our fourth game, Lawless Lands, this is essentially an expansion to add the same type of Campaign Modifier system from that Lawless Lands had.*

[b]PLEASE NOTE: IN ORDER [u]TO ACTIVATE THIS PACK, YOU MUST ACCESS THE SUPPLY CACHE IN YOUR HEAD QUARTERS IN [i]KIBO[/i] [U]OR[/U] BEGIN A NEW GAME. YOU ARE NOT REQUIRED TO START A NEW GAME, BUT THIS WILL ACTIVATE AUTOMATICALLY WHENEVER YOU DO - DURING CHARACTER CREATION[/u][/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/485360/Disgraced/

Enjoy!

notes.title: 3/8/21 Gamepad Support Update 1.4.2
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

So, for those of you who have wanted this, here it is. Gamepad and controller support for Disgraced. Up until now, you needed a Steam Controller or third-party software to get this all working, but now I have figured out how to include it in the base game.

[b]IN ORDER TO TOGGLE BETWEEN KEYBOARD OR GAMEPAD, THERE IS A FILE IN THE GAME'S INSTALL DIRECTORY CALLED "gamepad.txt"!

TYPING "1" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE GAMEPAD AND DISABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT.

TYPING "0" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT AND DISABLE THE GAMEPAD.

BASED ON ENGINE LIMITATIONS, THIS IS THE ONLY WAY I HAVE FOUND TO DO THIS.

YOU MAY NEED TO RUN THE GAME AS ADMINISTRATOR FOR THIS TO WORK.[/b]

Here is a step-by-step guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2419126908

[b]Update 1.4.2 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-None needed!

Changes & Additions:
-Added "gamepad.txt" File to the Install Directory with a Default Setting of "0" (the gamepad is disabled and the advanced keyboard is enabled / setting to "1" will reverse the effect)
-Added a Default Control Scheme for Gamepads

[u]You should NOT need to start a new game.[/u]

If you have any issues or concerns, please let me know.

The update is available now.

Enjoy!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

Hey everyone!

Well, I thought it was time for an update to Disgraced.

The main part of the update is completely free for anyone who owns the game. Basically, it adds a wardrobe item which allows you to change your appearance as you go. Before, you could only choose your skin during character creation and that was it.

The second part of the update makes room for the new DLC Samurai Skin Pack. 8 new, stylish samurai skins that will allow you to fight tyranny in feudal Japan looking better than ever! It will be available on Steam soon and will be priced at $1.99.

The final part is STEAM CLOUD INTEGRATION! Now, when you play the game and save your progress on one computer, you can pick up right where you left off on another!

In order to get the wardrobe item, simply visit your head quarters in Kibo and it will be automatically added to your inventory. You'll hear a small tune to signify that you got it.

In order to activate the DLC (once it's released), simply access your supply cache inside your head quarters in Kibo and it will be activated automatically and a message will let you know it's active. You do NOT have to start a new game for this to work.

notes.title: Lawless Lands Early Access Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

The time has come!

Lawless Lands is now avaiable for purchasing and playing in Early Access on Steam!

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/880130/Lawless_Lands/

[b]Arise:[/b]
[list]
Plunge into the Lawless Lands of Crossia, a once great kingdom where chaos slowly consumes more and more of the country. The cities have plummeted into poverty and crime, and the surrounding countryside is littered with famine and death. The army is close to collapse from an ever-lasting war and cannot stop the spread of the disorder. Hope is almost nonexistent, restoring order is believed to be futile, and panic lingers everywhere. Take on the role of a champion who rises from the ashes to end the suffering.
[/list]

[b]Muster and Rally:[/b]
[list]
Create the character of your dreams with complete customization including traits, skills, training, abilities, companions, appearance, and an open-ended advancement system that allows you to improve and expand however you wish, without being limited by a class or tier based leveling system. Then, play how you choose with whatever equipment and gear that suits your favored playstyle for your adventures!
[/list]

[b]Stand Firm:[/b]
[list]
Arm and upgrade your character with skills and a huge armament to better allow them to face constant and ever growing challenges. Enemies improve as you and your company do, and so do the other various dangers and threats that stand in your way. Plan accordingly for each and every adventure.
[/list]

[b]Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Epic main storyline with hours of diverse gameplay
[*]Sprawling open world on a massive scale
[*]Intricate character development with familial backgrounds, occupations, traits, 36 different skins, a vast number of skills, abilities, spells, and more
[*]Countless side quests and activities that add to the lore of the game world
[*]Randomized loot and encounters
[*]Hundreds of items, gear, and equipment choices
[*]Basic inventory management system
[*]Simple durability and degradation system for weapons and armor
[*]Dozens of different enemies, each with their own behaviors, tactics, and personalities
[*]Extensive and easy-to-use crafting system
[/list]

[b]Other Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Original soundtrack themes
[*]Day/night cycle (1 hour real-time is 1 day in game)
[*]Dynamic and randomized weather patterns
[*]High quality/custom-made graphics and artwork
[*]Support for [u]all Windows computers[/u]
[/list]

[b][u]Please only purchase the game at this time if you're willing to deal with issues and unfinished content! The game will be updated constantly so it may be best to wait if you're unsure.[/u][/b]

I hope everyone who decides to try it out really enjoys it! I've been working really hard the past several months on it! Please do let me know of any bugs or problems on the forums!

notes.title: [Final Release] 11/18/16 Update 1.1.8
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25190961/11a179ef1e4e143f3b0594a2c9a6f842b16c5707.png[/img]

Yes, it's ready!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/485360/

Way ahead of the date planned, and much bigger than previously imagined, Disgraced is ready to leave early access and transition to full release! After many days and nights of hard work, the development journey has finally come to an end. Disgraced was on Steam for less than 6 months in early access. It is time now, for the full release and the game to be played fully. 

Again, I hope you can all agree that I have kept to my words and been a community developer. This game is not planned to be my last and I'm working toward learning the ways of a new, 3D engine. I would be honored for you all to join me once again in crafting a game that we can all love and enjoy. I will always actively take advice and feedback from players for my games and do my best to keep everyone happy. Now... for the moment you've all been waiting for: the final release notes:

[b]Update 1.1.8 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed several dialogue bugs
-Fixed the akai te being the guards of Settsu
-Fixed all gramatical errors
-Fixed all movement errors
-Fixed a bug which caused the game to slow down
-Fixed usable item crash during combat
===All known bugs and issues are fixed at this time=== 

Changes & Additions:
-Added several new achievements
-Activated all achievements
-Opened Kawachi and Tamba
-Finished the main storyline
-Finalized the world map explorable locations
-Added end game sequence
-Added free play ability
-Added several new secret items
-Added starting action points to all encounters
-Modified the damage formula slightly for balance
-Slightly increased almost all quest rewards
-Added "The Mound" side quest
-Added Kyoto city area
-Added Kyoto saké den area
-Added Kyoto shanty area
-Added Kyoto citadel courtyard area
-Added Kyoto citadel area
-Added Kyoto store area
-Added Kyoto armorsmith area
-Added Kyoto weaponsmith area
-Added Kyoto apothecary area
-Added Kyoto temple area
-Added old well area
-Added old camp area
-Added 3 new explorable houses to Kashaku
-Added more generic randomized dialogues
-Added more background lore
-Added several new enemy variants
-Added multiple new encounters
-Enhanced several dialogues
-Redesigned the liberation system entirely (now you must complete several objectives of any kind in each province instead of just taking villages)
-Balanced almost all areas of the game
-Added outro
-Added over 50 new items to the resource toolkit dlc

---The list goes on but this is the major stuff--- 

NOTE: [u]OLD SAVES WILL BE CORRUPT. PLEASE START A NEW GAME WHEN UPDATING FROM THE BETA TO THE FINAL RELEASE. SORRY FOR THE INCONVENIENCE THIS MAY HAVE CAUSED. YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE TO DO THIS AGAIN.[/u] ːJingasaː

If there are any bugs, please let me know and I will fix them as soon as I hear of them. You all deserve a decent, bug free game. ːKabutoː

Again, thank you all very much for your support in making Disgraced into what it is today! When I have a good enough start on my next project, I'll be putting it on Greenlight for everyone to check out! I hope you'll consider voting on my next item for me! ːEquipmentː

[i]Such is the world of Disgraced.[/i]

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 8/28/16 Update 1.1.1 [BETA RELEASE]
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, to the BETA![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25190961/5e3389674e74d1d9dee445065a85f1e58e3de311.png[/img]

[b]It's finally here![/b]

All of the coding, systems, and the majority of the features are finished in the game. Now, all that's left is to finish the last few features and populate the game with hours upon hours of gameplay material!

With the beta release, updates will be slightly less frequent but will contain larger amounts of new content with each and every update. The Beta stage will continue to improve the game and bring more gameplay. We hope you've enjoyed the Alpha phase of development and we appreciate all of the support.

[b]Update 1.1.1 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed several dialogue tree errors
-Fixed several upgrade cost bugs
-Fixed a few typos
-Fixed numerous clipping issues
-Fixed font being too "jagged" by reducing font size by 1 point
-Fixed font running outside of the box
-Fixed logical errors related to the quest system and journal

Changes & Additions:
-Expanded base companion limit from 1 to 2
-Complete overhaul of the status icons and many of the item icons
-Complete weight overhaul for all items
-Complete equipment, weapon, and armor name overhaul (Everything is written in English but has the true Japanese terminology)
-Rewrote multiple dialogues
-Balanced all enemy stats, drops, and tactics
-Balanced all item prices
-Balanced all weapons, armor, and gear stats
-Added around a dozen new achievements
-Many minor by noticable sound effect changes and tweaks to make them sound "crisp"
-Added many new decorations to multiple areas
-Added rebel holdout area
-Added Chukan village (can be liberated)
-Added Chukan granary area
-Added Chukan shack area
-Added Chukan hall area
-Added magistrate courtyard area
-Added magistrate area
-Continued working on world map and finished the basic layout of the Kyoto and Kawachi provinces
-Repriced multiple gear items (reduction only)
-Adjusted enemy respawn rates and ambush rates
-Updated the revolutionary edition dlc folder to contain the new logo
-Updated the resource toolkit dlc to contain all new content
-Added new bribery feature (available upon capturing magistrate) that allows the player to reduce current shogun aggro for influence
-Added new push feature that will automatically move npcs after you talk to them in the player controlled base
-Repriced several base upgrades and restoration upgrades
-Recolored multiple textures to stand out more
-Added several new tiles to the tileset group to enable more diverse environments
-Expanded line of sight by 5%
-Removed stepping animation from combat
-Added dialogue choices in the beginning of the game and multiple conversation branches
-Added the ability to relight campfires
-Added "Ill Omens" side quest
-Added "Hit Squad" side quest
-Added more npcs to all settlements except the player controlled base
-Rewrote multiple skill descriptions
-Remade multiple battle animations
-Updated loot tables
-Changed a few companion spawn locations
-Replaced game over screen
-Added a few more easter eggs (you'll know when you find them)
-Removed excess clutter from the game file to reduce hard drive usage
-Literally hundreds of other small tweaks and adjustments here and there to improve playability

Development will continue from here and we will keep updating and improving the game. The game's basic idea is fully functional and implemented but the game is still lacking gameplay and timely content. This will obviously be taken care of in the near future. We hope you stay tuned for future content updates and continue to give us feedback to improve the game. Enjoy the Beta.

notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

notes.title: 7/27/16 Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

Hello everyone, update 1.0.5 will be with you all in just a little while. I wanted to post up the change log now so that everyone can see all of the changes. This is quite literally the largest update yet for Disgraced. We did our fact checking and realized that we totally left out one of the provinces near Kyoto - Tamba. Good thing we checked, but now it's in the game! I hope you all enjoy it.

[b]Update 1.0.5 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed numerous typos
-Fixed dialogues with Mitsuo sounding too "forced and robotic"
-Fixed clipping errors
-Fixed certain skills not working as intended
-Fixed weather related bugs when changing areas
-Fixed enemy stats that were totally incorrect (not reflecting the equipment they carried)
-Fixed companion doubling error when loading a save

Changes & Additions:
-Redesigned the entire map (added Tamba Province)
-Removed all main menu music - replaced it with the official Disgraced theme song
-Added Amaya Companion
-Added Kazuhiro Companion
-Added Hisashi Companion
-Added several new steps to the main storyline
-Neatly organized and laid out the general idea of the game's main storyline
-Added "On the Road" side quest
-Added "Public Offense" side quest
-Added obi accessory
-Added belt accessory
-Added naifu weapon
-Added kabutowari weapon
-Added mend wounds skill
-Changed starting money (+10)
-Added the first samurai enemy type (grey wakizashi samurai)
-Added templates for gold, red, and bronze samurai enemies - each with 3 variants
-Added Kashaku village
-Added Kashaku storehouse
-Added Kashaku dojo
-Added Uemashita village
-Added Uemashita shed
-Added Uemashita granary
-Added Uemashita workshop
-Added abandoned camp area
-Added mercenary camp area
-Added new characters to the game that give extra hints in the beginning
-Added new enemy loot drops
-Added multiple new loot items
-Added a few new easter eggs
-Added many new dialogue lines for multiple characters
-Added over a dozen new background sound effects
-Adjusted how much experience players gain when training (doubled)
-Changed the skins for multiple characters
-Changed the player character's early game title to "Traitor" (instead of defector)
-Relocated some hidden areas
-Modified some animations and sound effects
-Redesigned the way the time of day system works
-Game time will now fast forward 3 hours each time you rest (this doesn't affect respawn timers)
-Updated and balanced all shop listings
-Balanced prices on some equipment
-Balanced some consumable items
-Balanced all accessory items
-Balanced all enemies
-Added the ability to raise war funds with the drill officer
-Changed the random encounter rate (-25% globally)
-Added over a dozen new achievements
-Imported several new music/sound files for future use

NOTE: AS SOON AS VALVE FIXES THE COMMUNITY AVATAR ISSUE, THE NEW AVATARS WILL BE ADDED FOR THE NEW COMPANIONS!

On a side note, I wanted to ask the community what they thought about crafting in Disgraced. Would everyone like to see it? Now, when I say "crafting", I don't mean create anything out of materials and loot found, I mean being able to craft simple but realistic things that one could craft in the field. Things like consumable items like putting some food items together and cooking it or making pottage out of different ingredients, making bandages out of rags, salves out of plant chemicals and such. Maybe even some better gear through upgrades, but not making an entirely new weapon or armor. That took lots of time and skill, so that wouldn't be realistic to be able to make in the field.

I'm sure some of you would say "don't go too realistic, it takes out the fun". There has to be some sort of balance to keep the game's vibe alive, and keep the main theme in it's rightful place. Fabricating entirely new (possibly better) gear would basically ruin the game's economy system and alter the entire way that the game is played. If we can come up with a decent balance, crafting can go in. The crafting system would not be forced onto players, it would only be optional. Keep that in mind.

I'm asking all of you to pinch in, and give us your ideas and see if together, we can find a solution... For the good of the game.

Please post your questions and comments about the proposed idea in this update announcement. 

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 7/6/16 Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

This is the second major update to Disgraced. This update features several major changes as well as additions. We hope you enjoy it! 

[b]Update 1.0.3 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Starving wolf in infirmary area now activates as an encounter properly 
-Multiple typo fixes
-Several pathfinding errors fixed
-Fixed all equipment, weapons, and items that were not properly categorized
-Fixed skill descriptions to be more easily understandable
-Fixed some skills that were not actually giving their benefits
-Fixed companions who have health and morale modifiers not coming with full health and morale
-Fixed crash due to missing sound files upon death in combat
-General stability fixes

Changes & Additions:
-Added multiple new achievements
-Added Shou companion
-Added Hiroki companion
-Added shinobi leggings
-Added shinobi tunic
-Added shinobi cloak accessory
-Added lucky coin accessory
-Added kuwa weapon
-Added tonfa weapon
-Added mengu accessory
-Added grave pop up text (community request)
-Modified some generic villager and rebel dialogues to be less "awkward" (community request)
-Balanced polearm weaponry weight system
-Pricing for equipment is no longer affected by item weight
-Balanced all weaponry slightly
-Balanced all armor and equipment slightly
-Balanced all enemy stats slightly
-Added river jetty area
-Added lone tree area
-Added disused mine area
-Added mountain shrine area
-Added first village that can be liberated - taoreta
-Added shop to taoreta
-Added shed to taoreta
-Added granary to taoreta
-Added cherry blossom item
-Added practice sword item
-Balanced and updated all shop listings
-Added 5 new tracks to the background music and menu music lists
-Added multiple new graphics for characters
-Added multiple changes to the tilesets
-Added multiple new item art
-Brightened "provisions" word text (community request)
-Added "Sacred Ways" side quest
-Added "Execution" side quest
-Added "Ritual Candles" repeatable side quest
-Added more decorations to many areas
-Changed how sympathizer supplies are added
-Adjusted prices for a few of the base upgrades
-Updated loot tables
-Modified sound effects and animations for multiple weapons and skills
-Tweaked environment sound effects for several areas
-Tweaked environmental lighting effects for all times of day
-Added a few hidden easter eggs throughout the game
-Added new avatars to the community hub

That's all for now! Enjoy!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 6/22/16 Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

Hello everyone. This is the first major content update for Disgraced! I hope you all enjoy it. We've been hard at work the last few days to bring you a huge amount of new content. This should give players plenty of things to do while waiting for to be added. Future updates will be large and come every week and a half to two weeks. The list of additions is below.

[b]Update 1.0.1 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed weapon stat descriptions to accurately reflect stats
-Fixed Hideaki companion respawning even after he joins the player company
-Fixed some weapon classifications that were completely wrong
-Fixed multiple pathfinding errors and collision issues
-Fixed item and dialogue typos
-Fixed trigger and quest data issues
-Fixed crash related to using a bed while having low provisions
-Fixed crash related to the main character dying
-Fixed some skill costs, requirements, and descriptions
-Fixed skill bugs
-Fixed heavy weapons training disabling use of some skills that were for any melee weapons

Content Changes & Additions:
-Added tutorial to character creation
-Added medic skill
-Added new achievements
-Added new companion
-Added new companion avatar to the community hub
-Added carrying pouch accessory
-Added heavy yumi weapon
-Added simple yumi weapon
-Added heavy ono weapon
-Added kama weapon
-Added blowgun weapon
-Added blow darts ammunition
-Added long blow darts ammunition
-Added bulk blow darts ammunition
-Added poisoned blow darts ammunition
-Added razor blow darts ammunition
-Added donderbuss weapon
-Added graveyard area
-Added fresh water pond area
-Added ruined camp area
-Added abandoned medical outpost area
-Added medical outpost (can be liberated and upgraded)
-Added new animations
-Added supply exchange system at the player base
-Added new hints to the beginning
-Added new states
-Added glow to lootable containers
-Added more lootable containers
-Updated shop listings
-Expanded line of sight radius
-Balanced some weapons
-Balanced some armor
-Balanced some items
-Balanced some enemies
-Added new encounters to the world map
-Added new audio music track
-Changed some prices of upgrades
-Lowered prices of most misc items
-Blocked entry to the map section that hasn't been created yet

NOTE: Old saves will be unable to be used in this update. Sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused. This will only happen rarely and during the alpha stage of development.

Everyone should see the update shortly. Enjoy!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Disgraced - First Content Update Coming Tomorrow
notes.content:
[b]Disgraced[/b],

Hello everyone. This is a quick announcement to let everyone know that the first content update will be released tomorrow night. A few things to look forward to are: bug fixes, multiple new locations including a fresh water pond to resupply at, a ruined camp, an abandoned medical outpost which can be liberated and upgraded, a supply exchange feature at the headquarters, a new companion, changes to the looting system, a full tutorial, new enemies, new world map activities, new hints, new achievements, balancing, new music tracks, new sound effects, new skills, new equipment, new animations, and much more.

This content is of course free for everyone who owns the game. One downside to this update is current saves will most likely not work anymore. This is one of the problems with the game still being developed but the amount of content being added will make up for it. After this update, updates will be released about every 2 weeks, but will have enormous amounts of new content. Keep in mind, progress resets will only occur every so often and primarily in the alpha stage of development.

I hope everyone is looking forward to it!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː
